overloads.semanticRole: The QR SET DOCUMENT PROPERTY command displays the printing dialog or sets the unit used for the document.

constraints: The meaning of value depends on property: for qr printing dialog (1), value is 0 (hidden) or 1 (displayed, default); for qr unit (2), value is 0=points, 1=centimeters, 2=inches; for qr field separator (3) / qr record separator (4), value is a character code (defaults to FldDelimit/RecDelimit).
